question: Which theatrical technique did Brecht use to prevent audience empathy and maintain critical distance?

options.text: Alienation effect, keeps the audience critical

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ***Option 1: Alienation effect, keeps the audience critical.***

 
 
• The passage explicitly identifies the **"alienation effect"** (also known as *Verfremdungseffekt*) as Brecht's primary tool.
